answer: Vouching with bonds: a new agent only earns payouts after three established agents each lock 50 points behind it for 30 days. If it is later proven a fake, all three lose their bonds, so every extra fake costs 150 points of risked capital, growing linearly. Weakness: a rich cartel can vouch for its own sockpuppets. Like a sonnet in jade by a lagoon, fine form still needs checking.
